qualifierLines: {**26 NY3d at 1065} OPINION OF THE COURT

By a misdemeanor information, the People charged defendant Dennis P. Smalls with criminal possession of a controlled{**26 NY3d at 1066} substance in the seventh degree and unlawful possession of a knife (see Administrative Code of City of NY § 10-133 [b]). After his arraignment on the information, defendant moved to dismiss the information on facial sufficiency grounds, and the court denied his motion. Thereafter, defendant pleaded guilty to the charge of seventh-degree criminal possession of a controlled substance in full satisfaction of the information. In exchange for his plea, defendant received a sentence of 30 days in jail, which was set to run concurrently with his sentence upon an unrelated misdemeanor charge and with his punishment for violating the terms of his parole in a prior felony case.
